description: This Java source file defines the NotificationServices class, providing services for preparing and sending email notifications within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to generate email bodies from templates, handle email delivery, and manage URLs for notification links.

classes.name: NotificationServices
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate and send email notifications based on templates, including URL management for links within notifications.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Generates or uses a provided email body and sends an email via the 'sendMail' service. Handles errors and logs issues.

methods.name: prepareNotification
methods.description: Processes a specified email template with dynamic data, generates the email content, and returns it along with success or error messages.

methods.name: setBaseUrl
methods.description: Ensures the 'baseUrl' and 'baseSecureUrl' are set in the context, attempting to construct them from website and host information.
